Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

anumaan 0.1.0.9036

  • Prepared for CRAN submission: every exported example now runs, internal helpers no longer produce Rd pages, and console tables printed during preprocessing are emitted with message() so suppressMessages() silences them.
  • Pathway 1 now works with osqp >= 1.0. osqp 1.0 removed the $solve() method, so every osqp solve errored and estimate_profiles_convex(), compute_resistance_profiles() and bootstrap_profiles_convex() silently returned uniform profile probabilities flagged as non-converged. They now call osqp::solve_osqp(), which works across osqp versions.
  • compute_marginals_from_data() and compute_pairwise_from_data() no longer drop antibiotic classes whose names contain hyphens, slashes or spaces (e.g. “Third-generation-cephalosporins”), which preprocess_for_profiles() had renamed when pivoting to wide format.
  • Organism, drug and syndrome names are now compared case-insensitively through one lower-case key. As a result org_group and rr_pathogen are populated for run_preprocess() output (previously “Other” and NA for every row), and panel_map, syndrome_name and pathogen_name arguments match regardless of case; outputs keep the data’s own labels. The derived keys rr_pathogen and the pathogen column of daly_load_rr_reference() are now lower case.
  • Fixed inst/extdata/adjustment_for_CFR.csv: an unquoted comma in “Infections of bones, joints, and related organs” corrupted that row.
  • Functions that take a seed argument now restore the caller’s random number generator state on exit.
  • preprocess_for_profiles() no longer errors at the deduplication step; it now deduplicates isolate x drug rows before collapsing to antibiotic class level.
  • daly_calc_yll_associated() and daly_load_rr_reference() now read the bundled CSV reference tables (the .xlsx files they expected are no longer shipped).

anumaan 0.1.0.9021

  • Expanded the specimen classification reference with stewardship sample labels seen in 2021-era extracts, including brain abscess, instrument, lung aspirate, lymph node, hair, and superficial biopsy.
  • Collapsed sterile_classification outputs from detailed reference labels to Sterile, Non-Sterile, and Others/Ambiguous for downstream analysis.
  • Made EDA and burden plotting functions usable without ggpubr; when ggpubr is not installed, eda_theme() falls back to ggplot2::theme_bw().
  • Refreshed vignettes and installation guidance for the 0.1.0.9021 workflow.
